gb.title: 10 Factors to Consider When Getting the Right Product Packaging
gb.description: It has increasingly become important for entrepreneurs to think about their attitudes when it comes to the green movement and the environment. Basically, being sustainable is vital for this planet and will make a difference in how a business would be perceived by everyone, including suppliers, employees, and clients. With the growing demand for businesses to use sustainable packaging, around 60% of customers are willing to pay more for products. The packaging is everything to businesses and would be the first thing individuals will see. Working with Mil spec packaging can definitely help you with your branded packaging work. Therefore, if you want to maintain the loyalty of clients and get new customers, it is important to consider the following factors when getting your product packaging: Branding The type of packaging you consider may be an extension of your branding. In case your brand concentrates on vegan or organic, you may want to go for packaging materials with these ethics. Always think about using eco-friendly materials so as to incorporate your packaging into your branding efforts and overall message. Beyond that, you will also have to style your packaging with logo, product information, and colours, so always bear this in mind when choosing the right packaging materials for all your products. Budget Before you start your packaging endeavour, you need to evaluate the scope of your budget. With this, you will be able to determine the types of materials you may use, and the amount of money you might spend to make your design enticing. Materials, such as natural fibres and glass look terrific and visually appealing to customers, though they are expensive to ship or manufacture. Glass materials are also breakable and heavy, resulting in storage and shipping concerns. Professional manufacturers, such as Mitchel-Lincoln Packaging , recommend budget-friendly options, like food-grade cardboard and plastic. Food-grade cardboards are relatively cheap and offer interesting design opportunities as well as protection. On the other hand, plastics are recyclable, making them a convenient material to manufacture product packaging. Distribution If you intend to distribute products made of glass, you will have to make sure they are properly packaged. The same should happen to your heavy products. To distribute such products, you might consider accessories, like metal or plastic straps, to keep your boxes in good shape when transporting. For businesses in the beverage industry, finding the right balance between weight and durability is a common challenge. Many wineries want the premium look of glass but need to manage their shipping costs. Choosing lightweight options for wholesale wine bottles helps reduce overall freight weight and still keeps the classic look. This choice also helps lower the carbon footprint during transit. Suppliers often have different glass weights available to fit various budgets and shipping needs. Durability is also tantamount to successful packaging, so you should consider the ease and function of transport. You may not want to develop an eye-popping and original packaging, only to lose shape before it gets to its final destination. Audience When getting the right product packaging, always keep your audience at the forefront. Besides, it’s your clients who will be enticed to products when your packaging is visually appealing. For you to attract clients, it is important to understand them and research them before you take any packaging decision. Storage Space Whether or not your budget for packaging is sufficient, you might lack enough space to store everything. Although most packaging manufacturers opt to sell their products in bulk or large quantities, it’s important to seek low-order minimums. This way, you’ll manage your storage space while ensuring that you protect and package the orders of your clients. Nature of Products The nature of your products may determine the kind of packaging you will use. For instance, you need to pack food products in approved and safe bags with protective seals against possible tampering or contamination. Similarly, chemical and drug packaging supplies need to meet the required criteria. On this note, you should use product descriptions and labels for safe handling. Convenience It is important to choose strong packaging materials. Perhaps one, which your customers can pre-heat when they get frozen. Plastic retail packaging can also be convenient because it can help to prevent food from packaging. You can as well use packaging materials, which enhances the acceptability of your products. To achieve this, you need to use transparent packaging to allow individuals to see and judge your products when buying. Environment Although painted and eye-catching packaging can capture potential client's attention, it might do so for the wrong reasons. With the charged environment, packaging that people cannot recycle is regarded as a hazard. Basically, there is greater awareness regarding the harmful impacts of using plastic packaging, which you cannot recycle or reuse. Ignoring this fact may result in tarnishing the image of your business. Hence, it is important to consider green packaging so as to uphold the environment and avoid wrath from disappointed clients. Design It is always important to keep your products in mind when choosing the right packaging design . This step will ensure that your design goes hand in hand with products to ensure your merchandises have a maximum impact on marketing. You need to always prioritize your products to make sure they don’t interfere with packaging design. You may as well incorporate the packaging colours to ensure they reflect your products and brand. Your packaging design needs to also consider many factors, including durability, storage space, safety, shelf space, and size, just to name a few. The significance of choices in material, design, and size will impact your success. Trend The increased responsibility of product labels and packages finally lands on the graphic designers’ shoulders. They ought to put their creativity to design a product package, which may serve as a salesperson for products. However, as an entrepreneur, your main goal should not be based on in-store experience alone. It also has to meet the needs of customers. To achieve this, you will need product packaging, which is trending. At times, it is all right when your product material is not trending. You may use different materials, start a trend, or consider existing ones and let them trend in the market once more. Final Remarks! With the complex compliance requirements and supply chains, manufacturers have many things to put into consideration when it comes to packaging decisions. The right type of packaging can protect your products to ensure they are distributed while in good condition. However, not every packaging material is created equal. Some possess features, which meet specific requirements, like the packaging for perishable products. To choose the right product packaging, you need to consider some of the above factors, if not all.

fr.title: Saint-Dizier : au Vert-Bois, la course de caisses à savon prend de la vitesse
fr.description: Lecture zen Le bolide du Super Mario bragard en 2025. - Archives Dix-sept bolides en 2025, vingt-cinq attendus cette année : à Saint-Dizier, la course de caisses à savon du quartier du Vert-Bois revient dimanche 20 septembre 2026 avenue du Président-Kennedy. Une manifestation née de l’initiative des habitants qui, au-delà de son caractère spectaculaire, est devenue un véritable projet collectif. À lire aussi Journées du patrimoine : Saint-Dizier ouvre ses coulisses Les courses de caisses à savon sont maintenant un phénomène populaire en France. Celle du Vert-Bois appartient cependant à une catégorie particulière. Ici, pas de grande marque ni de sponsor derrière l’événement : l’idée est née en 2025 au sein du comité d’animation du Centre socioculturel du quartier, avec le soutien logistique de la Ville. Et le succès a été immédiat : dix-sept véhicules engagés et près d’un millier de spectateurs. Des véhicules supplémentaires Pour la deuxième édition, dimanche 20 septembre, le changement d’échelle est déjà perceptible. Vingt-cinq bolides sont annoncés, construits à Saint-Dizier, dans les environs et au-delà. Cette année, la Mission locale s’est associée à l’aventure. Tout au long de l’été, des jeunes en recherche d’emploi ont travaillé avec des seniors du Centre socioculturel à la conception d’une caisse à savon. Le projet a bénéficié de l’atelier de l’Afpa (Agence nationale pour la formation professionnelle des adultes) pour sa construction et de l’aide de l’Arit (Association pour la rencontre et l’insertion par le travail) pour confectionner les tenues de l’équipe. « La démarche permet aux jeunes de prendre conscience de compétences qui peuvent être valorisées dans leur recherche d’emploi » souligne ainsi Clémence Collado, directrice de la Mission locale qui ajoute : « Le travail aux côtés de seniors ayant une longue expérience professionnelle leur donne aussi l’occasion de créer des contacts et de se constituer un réseau. » Les équipes bragardes seront nombreuses. Deux véhicules seront présentés par l’école privée l’Estic et deux autres par les services techniques de la Ville. Parmi ces derniers figurera une caisse aux couleurs de Miko, à l’effigie de la célèbre tour devenue l’un des symboles de Saint-Dizier. Les pompiers auront également leur bolide, tandis que le magasin Les Arcadiens reviendra avec une création inspirée de l’univers du jeu vidéo. L’an dernier, les concurrents les plus rapides avaient atteint 67 km/h La course attire aussi des concurrents venus de l’extérieur de Saint-Dizier. Cinq bolides feront notamment le déplacement depuis la Marne, tandis qu’une équipe viendra de Chaumont. S’y ajoutera la Team CAS du Puits, déjà habituée à ce type de compétition. Une participation extérieure qui témoigne, dès cette deuxième édition, du rayonnement pris par la manifestation au-delà de Saint-Dizier . Le terrain de jeu est à la hauteur. Depuis le sommet de l’avenue du Président-Kennedy, les concurrents devront parcourir 550 mètres sur une pente atteignant 17 %. L’an dernier, les plus rapides avaient atteint 67 km/h. Le virage à hauteur de l’église Sainte-Thérèse constituera l’une des principales difficultés. Casque et gants rigides seront obligatoires et les véhicules, sans moteur, devront satisfaire au contrôle technique organisé dès 8 heures. À lire aussi Deux Rafale de la base aérienne 113 partent pour un tour du monde de 40 000 kilomètres Après les essais à partir de 9 heures, les descentes chronométrées se succéderont de 10 h 30 à 12 h 30 puis de 13 h 30 à 17 h 30. Les organisateurs espèrent permettre à chaque équipage d’effectuer cinq à six passages. La remise des prix aura lieu à 18 heures. Buvette, restauration, structures gonflables et quads électriques compléteront la journée. Une idée fédératrice Mais derrière la vitesse et les carrosseries improbables, la manifestation joue aussi un rôle dans la vie du Vert-Bois. En deux éditions, une idée lancée par des habitants est parvenue à réunir jeunes, seniors, associations, écoles et services municipaux tout en attirant des concurrents extérieurs. Le Centre socioculturel et son comité d’animation songent déjà à prolonger cette dynamique. Mokhtar Khalhal, adjoint chargé des associations, évoque ainsi un projet de jeux interquartiers organisés à tour de rôle dans différents secteurs de Saint-Dizier. Encore au stade de la réflexion, cette nouvelle initiative repose sur la même idée : lorsqu’une manifestation part des habitants, elle peut rapidement prendre de l’ampleur. La course de caisses à savon semble, elle, bien partie pour devenir l’un des rendez-vous populaires de la rentrée bragarde. Una pena que cierre Twinner, la tienda de deportes vinculada a Gómez Becerra desde hace unos veinte años. Su dueño empezó en Rebote con 19, pero este martes será su último día detrás del mostrador. Huye del protagonismo, le gusta pasar inadvertido, pero la marcha de su negocio es una noticia que deja huérfana a Cáceres y hay que contarlo.

El esplendor de Villagarcía aún permanece gracias a la longevidad de la piedra que da forma a su Colegiata herreriana de San Luis, primer templo contrarreformista de Castilla, inspiración para las misiones en América y escuela de sacrificados jesuitas, que aún hoy llora el mundo, con Valladolid a la cabeza.

mx.title: Una ciudad lunar de 1 millón: 100 años con 30 veces el agua
mx.description: ✨︎ Resumen (TL;DR): Martin Elvis y Jonathan McDowell calcularon que una ciudad de un millón de personas agotaría mil millones de toneladas de agua en unos 100 años con un reciclaje de 98%. Las mejores estimaciones actuales apuntan a unos 34 millones de toneladas, cerca de 30 veces menos, y recortarían ese plazo a unos 3.4 años. La energía podría cubrir la demanda de un millón de habitantes, pero el agua limitaría la población lunar de largo plazo a unos cientos de miles. Martin Elvis y Jonathan McDowell, astrofísicos del Centro de Astrofísica Harvard-Smithsonian, calcularon que una ciudad de un millón de personas en la Luna agotaría mil millones de toneladas de agua en unos 100 años, aun reciclando 98%, el nivel que alcanzó la Estación Espacial Internacional (EEI) en 2023. El escenario ya es generoso: las mejores estimaciones actuales apuntan a una reserva unas 30 veces menor, así que la autonomía caería a poco más de tres años. La revista Frontiers in Space Technologies publicó el informe breve y revisado por pares el 14 de septiembre de 2026. Elvis y McDowell compararon el consumo de una ciudad con el hielo disponible en la región polar. Su resultado es directo: la energía no sería el freno; el agua sí. Te podría interesar: Voyager 1: la nave que se apaga a un día luz de la Tierra Foto: Diana ✨ / Pexels El cálculo parte de una reserva generosa Una trampa fría es una región polar en sombra permanente que conserva hielo porque la temperatura impide que se evapore. Los fondos de cráteres cercanos a los polos no reciben luz solar directa desde hace unos 4,000 millones de años . En las trampas que nunca superan 110 kelvin , unos -163 °C , el hielo pierde como máximo un milímetro cada mil millones de años. El supuesto de mil millones de toneladas equivale a un kilómetro cúbico de agua. El volumen bastaría para llenar el área de Central Park de Nueva York hasta 120 metros de altura. La cifra no sale de las mediciones más recientes. El primer reporte sólido basado en radar apareció en 2013 y sugirió varios cientos de millones de toneladas alrededor del polo sur. Un metaanálisis de 2022 sobre 65 grandes regiones en sombra calculó del orden de 34 millones de toneladas en los ocho cráteres con más volátiles. Un trabajo de 2026 con la cámara ShadowCam confirmó hielo en apenas 3.5% de las trampas frías, aunque en esas zonas podría llegar a 30% del peso de la mezcla con el regolito. Los autores admiten que los 34 millones de toneladas podrían ser una subestimación por un factor de tres, pero consideran exagerado suponer diez veces más. Tampoco todo el hielo sería recuperable. Como referencia, en los yacimientos de petróleo se extrae entre 33% y 50% ; la fracción lunar solo se conocerá con datos tomados en el terreno. Aun así, el informe adopta los mil millones de toneladas como base y permite escalar todos sus resultados desde ese volumen. La energía no limita a un millón de habitantes Con el consumo residencial más alto de Estados Unidos, un millón de personas requeriría 800 megavatios . Al sumar la industria, la demanda subiría a unos 2.1 gigavatios . Un análisis de 2023 , del que Martin Elvis es coautor, calculó que paneles solares montados en torres de un kilómetro sobre los bordes de los cráteres polares, casi siempre iluminados, podrían entregar en promedio unos 3 gigavatios durante 90% del tiempo . Para varios millones de habitantes haría falta energía nuclear de fisión. Con esas cifras, los autores no identifican a la generación eléctrica como el límite principal. En cambio, calculan que el agua podría restringir la población lunar de largo plazo a unos cientos de miles de personas. El problema aparece al comparar ese techo con las metas de expansión lunar. En febrero de 2026 , Elon Musk escribió en X que SpaceX ya había cambiado su foco a construir una ciudad lunar capaz de crecer por sí sola. Musk planteó que ese objetivo podría llegar en menos de 10 años , frente a los más de 20 años que tomaría Marte, según recogió ABC News. Jeff Bezos ha propuesto mudar la industria pesada a la Luna. Para que esas propuestas pesen en la economía humana, el estudio asume una escala de al menos 1% de la población mundial , unos 80 millones de personas . Jonathan McDowell, quien cree que tarde o temprano habrá asentamientos lunares, dijo que el objetivo del trabajo era "echar agua fría, literalmente, a parte de ese exceso de optimismo". El reciclaje compra tiempo, pero no crea agua El modelo asigna 500 toneladas de agua por persona al año . De esa cantidad, 125 toneladas cubren bebida y aseo, mientras unas 2 toneladas sirven para producir el oxígeno respirable al separar moléculas de agua. La comida se lleva el resto. El Banco Mundial estima entre 2 y 5 toneladas diarias para alimentar a una persona. Los autores suponen que mejores cultivos podrían reducir esa cifra a la mitad del mínimo. Incluso con ese recorte, los cultivos triplican el consumo doméstico y se llevan unas tres cuartas partes del total. Sin reciclaje, un millón de personas agotaría los mil millones de toneladas en unos dos años. Martin Elvis calificó ese plazo de "ridículamente corto": "Ni siquiera se podría construir la ciudad en ese tiempo". Hasta 2023, la EEI reciclaba 94% de su agua. Ese año, la NASA añadió un procesador de salmuera al sistema que trata la orina, elevó la cifra a 98% y redujo las pérdidas a la tercera parte. Con solo 2% de pérdida, una ciudad lunar de un millón duraría unos 100 años. Martin Elvis lo resumió así: "Sigue sin ser mucho, dada la inversión para construirla". La comparación con la EEI tampoco cubre toda la vida cotidiana. Una ciudad real tendría lavandería y duchas, que la estación no tiene, además de sanitarios diseñados para funcionar con un sexto de la gravedad terrestre . El estudio advierte que esas instalaciones podrían empeorar la eficiencia del reciclaje. Con el mismo 98% de reciclaje, una ciudad de 100,000 habitantes tardaría 1,000 años en agotar el volumen base. Los autores consideran que ese plazo basta para llamarla sostenible. Una aldea de unas 1,000 personas , comparable con la población que pasa el invierno en la Antártida, podría usar el agua con relativa tranquilidad; con 100,000 habitantes habría que empezar a cuidarla. Para que la ciudad de un millón llegue a 1,000 años con mil millones de toneladas, las pérdidas tendrían que caer a la décima parte. Eso exigiría un reciclaje superior a 99.75% , una meta difícil de alcanzar y mantener incluso para una población disciplinada y motivada. Con 500 toneladas por persona al año, el modelo da estos plazos: Reciclaje del agua Con mil millones de toneladas Con 34 millones de toneladas 0% 2 años unos 25 días 98%, nivel de la EEI desde 2023 100 años unos 3.4 años 99% 200 años unos 6.8 años 99.9% 2,000 años unos 68 años Incluso con 99.9% de reciclaje, por encima de la meta de 99.75%, la reserva de 34 millones de toneladas solo rendiría unos 68 años. El estudio considera difícil sostener ese nivel durante generaciones. El agua rinde más como combustible que para sostener ciudades El mismo volumen cambia de escala cuando se usa como combustible. Una segunda etapa de Starship consume 1,200 toneladas de propelente que no se recuperan. Mil millones de toneladas de agua alcanzarían para casi un millón de esos lanzamientos , unas 3 misiones diarias durante 1,000 años . Para ese uso, el estudio sí considera abundante el hielo. La cuenta apenas cambia aunque Starship queme metano, que podría fabricarse con hidrógeno del agua y carbono. Traer agua desde otros cuerpos, probablemente asteroides, exigiría una logística mucho mayor. Con el reciclaje de la EEI, una ciudad de un millón tendría que desembarcar 10 millones de toneladas al año . Eso equivale a unos 27 módulos diarios de 1,000 toneladas cada uno, unas 10 veces lo que puede transportar el módulo de alunizaje Starship HLS. Los autores advierten que la oferta de asteroides fáciles de alcanzar podría convertirse en un factor limitante. La comida ofrece otra forma de reducir la demanda. La agricultura vertical y una dieta con poca o ninguna carne podrían recortar mucho el consumo. Una granja vertical citada en el estudio produce fresas con 97% menos agua que el cultivo tradicional; el efecto sería grande si el método sirviera para otros cultivos. La carne de res requiere al menos seis veces más agua por kilo que la soya, otra diferencia que los autores incorporan al discutir el consumo alimentario. Falta medir el hielo en el sitio Las mediciones orbitales todavía tienen un límite de profundidad. Los detectores de neutrones sondean solo de 1 a 2 metros , mientras el radar llega a 10 o 20 metros y detecta mejor los bloques de hielo que el hielo repartido entre la roca. El regolito suelto de la superficie suele tener decenas de metros de espesor y podría guardar agua en las trampas frías. Si apareciera el doble de agua, la vida de un asentamiento se duplicaría. Los autores también reconocen que las estimaciones pueden corregirse en cualquier dirección. Una perforación en el sitio sería definitiva para cada punto muestreado. La NASA prevé que su róver VIPER, que buscará hielo en el polo sur, llegue a finales de 2027 con un taladro de un metro . Hasta que lleguen esos datos, los autores piden planear y regular el hielo polar, no repartirlo por orden de llegada. Martin Elvis planteó el problema como un asunto entre China y Estados Unidos, o entre los socios de Artemis y los de la estación de investigación lunar. Sin cooperación, advirtió, "lo único que tenemos es un sálvese quien pueda". El siguiente paso no es otra estimación desde órbita: una perforación en el sitio dirá cuánto hielo puede recuperarse en cada punto muestreado. in.title: Meta to alert Indian law enforcement on child sexual abuse, safety issues
in.description: New Delhi: As the government steps up engagement with social media platforms over harmful content online, US-based technology giant Meta has agreed to report matters related to child sexual abuse and safety to appropriate law enforcement agencies in India. The decision comes amid heightened scrutiny of Meta in India over the alleged circulation and promotion of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) through advertisements on Instagram. The Centre said the online safety of children is a fundamental principle for every social media platform operating in India and remains non-negotiable, as per government sources. Moreover, the commitment by the technology firm is being seen as a first step towards strengthening safeguards for children on social media platforms, they added. Social media platforms can be used to circulate or facilitate access to CSAM and other forms of child exploitation. Reporting such cases to law enforcement agencies would help ensure that incidents are not dealt with solely through platforms' internal content-moderation systems. In addition, the government stressed that more needs to be done and that discussions are continuing with other social media platforms to proactively identify and remove harmful content. It has also warned that action could be taken against platforms that fail to adopt adequate proactive measures to protect children online. The issue comes amid growing global scrutiny of social media platforms over risks to children, including exposure to sexual exploitation, harmful content and online abuse. In India, social media platforms are governed by the Information Technology Act and the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, which prescribe due-diligence obligations for intermediaries. Additionally, Meta ran more than 300 ads featuring AI-generated child sexual abuse material, according to an investigation. Its Facebook and Instagram platforms carried paid advertisements featuring child sexual abuse material (CSAM) this year, including AI-manipulated images of real children, as per the Tech Transparency Project (TTP).

sg.title: Jeep Unveils the 2027 Wrangler JL-2A as a Heritage Tribute to Its Post-WWII CJ-2A Origins
sg.description: Summary Jeep introduced the 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A as a limited-edition model paying tribute to the original post-war civilian CJ-2AThe package features heavy archival styling cues including retro 17-inch Joose-painted wheels and Heritage Tan Nappa leatherArriving as the 11th drop in the monthly "Twelve 4 Twelve" series, the package costs just $115 more than a similarly equipped Rubicon Over 80 years ago, the end of fighting in 1945 saw the World War II Willys MB military vehicle adapted for civilian work across farms, ranches and job sites. That pivotal transition birthed the original CJ-2A and sparked a lineage that directly evolved into the modern off-roader. Jeep paid homage to those archival roots with the 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A. Arriving as a detailed limited edition, the release underscores how the utilitarian DNA of the 1940s still commands cultural relevance in today's 4x4 landscape. The tribute vehicle arrived as the 11th consecutive entry in the "Twelve 4 Twelve" series, a rollout that introduces a new limited-edition Wrangler once a month for 12 straight months.Built upon the Jeep Wrangler Rubicon platform, the new edition delivers heritage styling without an aggressive markup. The JL-2A package costs $4,995 USD, meaning the fully appointed vehicle costs just $115 USD more than a similarly equipped Wrangler Rubicon. Visually, the drop is anchored by a two-door version available in Gobi paint, a shade drawing direct inspiration from the Harvest Tan color worn by the original CJ-2A. Buyers looking for different aesthetics can also specify the exterior in '41, Bright White, Sting Gray, Ghost or a bold orange shade named Joose.Every configuration locks in a set of 17-inch retro wheels painted Joose. These rims serve as a modern interpretation of the classic Sunset Red wheels originally offered on the CJ-2A, bridging the gap between archival design and contemporary trail readiness. The retro wheels are wrapped in 33-inch BFGoodrich KO2 all-terrain tires. Orange front and rear tow hooks, a functional three-piece hardtop, body-color fender flares and Dark Metallic Grey grille accents round out the exterior details.Inside the cabin, the aesthetic continues to lean into the archives. The interior design fuses Heritage Tan Nappa leather with Bison Brown trim and Desert Orange stitching. Archival cabin details elevate the space further, including heritage-inspired HVAC graphics, a Willys-Overland shifter medallion and a special serialized plaque mounted on the rear swing gate. Equipment remains modern despite the nostalgia. The JL-2A features a standard front TrailCam with an integrated washer along with the Convenience Group that provides remote start, an auto-dimming rearview mirror and a universal garage door opener. sg.title: Ford Files Patent for a System That Moves a Parked Truck Using Its Tailgate Handle
sg.description: Summary Ford Global Technologies secures a patent allowing pickup trucks to be moved from the outside via the tailgate handleThe push-to-move system lets operators inch a vehicle forward or backward to assist with exterior workSafety features like a dead-man switch and parking sensors ensure intentional, incident-free operation Ford Global Technologies has officially secured U.S. patent #12,728,722, introducing a control mechanism designed to let operators move a stationary pickup truck without entering the cab. Officially titled "Systems and methods for moving a vehicle using externally mounted HMI," the documentation outlines a physical interface that provides a manual solution for interacting with a stationary rig. This filing prioritizes a functional fix for inching a vehicle along during manual labor.At the core of the newly patented system is the physical pop-up grab handle situated at the rear of the pickup. This component is currently an optional part of the tailgate step on Ford F-series trucks, but the patent gives it movement functionality. Under this design, the operator pushes on the rear handle to request movement, prompting the stationary pickup truck to move forward or backward in small increments. The mechanism is responsive to human input, meaning that pushing harder on the handle could cause the truck to travel a farther distance. Alternatively, applying harder pressure to the handle could deliver a rapid series of more frequent, equal-size nudges. Operation is fully bidirectional and works just as seamlessly in reverse.Handing control of a multi-ton pickup to an operator standing outside the cab requires safety countermeasures. Documentation for the Ford patent notes that onboard parking sensors, alongside monitoring systems, track surroundings to prevent incidents at either end of the vehicle. To eliminate the risk of an accidental activation, the system could be programmed to move the truck only after the operator deliberately applies pressure to the handle and then releases it. This description also emphasizes the addition of a dedicated dead-man switch, a failsafe implemented to confirm that the operator's physical input on the rear handle is intentional before the drivetrain engages.The driving force behind this specialized innovation is assisting users who are manually unloading heavy landscaping materials, moving payloads like stone, dirt or mulch a little bit at a time. Traditionally, inching a vehicle along a job site while dumping materials requires constant stopping and starting, demanding a driver in the cab alongside a worker in the bed. By putting the physical movement controls directly on the rear handle, the mechanism turns a two-person job into a solo endeavor, giving a single worker exterior command over the Ford truck's exact position. sg.title: Sri Lanka's javelin champ returns to 'broken' welcome
sg.description:
Colombo: Sri Lanka's Asian Games medal prospect Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage returned home after winning the title at a top international event on Tuesday to find his prized javelins in pieces.

The 23-year-old rising star, who has taken the javelin world by storm this year with a series of impressive victories, was heartbroken to discover that his javelins had snapped.

"This was a rude shock," Pathirage's coach, Tony Prasanna, told AFP. "We checked in five javelins -- all packed extremely carefully and well -- but all of them arrived broken."

Pathirage posted a photograph of his damaged javelins on social media, listing the distance he had thrown them; "85.98, 92.62, 88.50, 89.20, 89.37, 88.20, 89.68, 92.06, 91.06 good bye".

Pathirage was returning from the World Athletics Ultimate Championships in Hungary on Turkish Airlines, and had lodged a complaint.

There was no immediate comment from the airline.

"It is not the cost of a javelin, which is quite high, but the emotional attachment," Prasanna said.

"This is a psychological setback for Rumesh and I will counsel him on it. We were planning to take three of these javelins to the 2028 Olympics and to the Asian Games."

Sri Lanka's Ministry of Sports said it would provide new javelins for Pathirage to compete at the Asian Games in Japan's Nagoya.

"The government will take up this matter with the airline and take appropriate legal action," the ministry said in a statement.

The ministry said that Pathirage -- the first Sri Lankan to become a Diamond League champion -- was the country's gold-medal hopeful at the Asian Games.

Pathirage hurled a world-leading 92.62 metres (303.87 feet) in the Rome Diamond League meet on June 4, and in Zurich last month his 92.07 saw him become only the fourth man in history to exceed 92m twice.

At the Asian Games, he will face Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem, who holds the Asian record of 92.97m.

India's javelin star Neeraj Chopra is injured and unable to defend his Asian Games gold.

id.title: Jeep Luncurkan Wrangler JL-2A 2027, Penghormatan bagi CJ-2A Pasca-Perang Dunia II
id.description: Ringkasan Jeep memperkenalkan 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A sebagai model edisi terbatas yang menjadi penghormatan untuk CJ-2A sipil pascaperang versi original.Paket ini hadir dengan sentuhan gaya arsip yang kental, termasuk velg retro 17 inci berlapis cat Joose dan jok kulit Nappa Heritage Tan.Sebagai rilisan ke-11 dalam seri bulanan "Twelve 4 Twelve", paket ini dibanderol hanya US$115 lebih mahal dibanding Rubicon dengan spesifikasi serupa. Lebih dari 80 tahun lalu, berakhirnya pertempuran pada 1945 membuka jalan bagi kendaraan militer Willys MB dari Perang Dunia II untuk diadaptasi menjadi kendaraan sipil yang digunakan di pertanian, peternakan, dan lokasi kerja. Transisi penting ini melahirkan CJ-2A orisinal sekaligus memulai silsilah yang berkembang langsung menjadi kendaraan off-road modern. Jeep memberi penghormatan pada akar historis tersebut melalui Jeep Wrangler JL-2A 2027. Hadir sebagai edisi terbatas yang dirancang dengan detail, model ini menegaskan bahwa DNA utilitarian era 1940-an masih relevan secara kultural dalam lanskap kendaraan 4x4 masa kini. Kendaraan tribut ini menjadi rilisan ke-11 berturut-turut dalam seri "Twelve 4 Twelve", yang menghadirkan Wrangler edisi terbatas baru setiap bulan selama 12 bulan tanpa jeda.Berbasis Jeep Wrangler Rubicon, edisi baru ini menawarkan gaya bernuansa warisan tanpa kenaikan harga yang berlebihan. Paket JL-2A dibanderol US$4.995, sehingga harga kendaraan dengan kelengkapan penuh ini hanya US$115 lebih mahal dibandingkan Wrangler Rubicon dengan spesifikasi serupa. Secara visual, rilisan ini berpusat pada versi dua pintu yang tersedia dalam warna Gobi, nuansa yang terinspirasi langsung dari warna Harvest Tan pada CJ-2A orisinal. Pembeli yang menginginkan estetika berbeda juga dapat memilih eksterior berwarna '41, Bright White, Sting Gray, Ghost, atau warna oranye berani bernama Joose.Setiap konfigurasi dibekali satu set pelek retro 17 inci berwarna Joose. Pelek ini merupakan interpretasi modern atas pelek Sunset Red klasik yang dahulu ditawarkan untuk CJ-2A, menjembatani desain arsip dengan kesiapan melintasi medan masa kini. Pelek retro tersebut dibalut ban segala medan BFGoodrich KO2 berukuran 33 inci. Detail eksteriornya dilengkapi kait derek depan dan belakang berwarna oranye, hardtop tiga bagian yang fungsional, overfender sewarna bodi, serta aksen kisi-kisi berwarna Dark Metallic Grey.Di dalam kabin, estetikanya tetap mengusung nuansa arsip. Desain interior memadukan kulit Nappa Heritage Tan, trim Bison Brown, dan jahitan Desert Orange. Detail kabin bernuansa historis semakin memperkaya ruang ini, termasuk grafis HVAC yang terinspirasi gaya klasik, medali tuas persneling Willys-Overland, serta plakat serial khusus yang dipasang pada pintu belakang berengsel samping. Meski sarat nostalgia, perlengkapannya tetap modern. JL-2A hadir dengan TrailCam depan berstandar lengkap dengan pencuci terintegrasi, serta Convenience Group yang mencakup fitur start jarak jauh, kaca spion tengah dengan peredupan otomatis, dan pembuka pintu garasi universal. ph.title: Transfer of Romualdez to QC jail ‘done according to law, due process’ —Palace
ph.description: Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez's transfer to the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas was in accordance with the law and due process, Malacañang said. When asked to react to the transfer of Romualdez, the President's cousin, Palace Press Officer and Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, said all the administration could say was that it was what had to be done in accordance with the law. "In general, nadinig naman po natin kung ano naman po talaga ang nararapat, kung ano ang sinasabi ng batas, anong sinasabi ng proseso, iyon lang naman din po ang masasabi ng pamahalaang ito, ng administrasyon na ito (In general, we have heard what should be done, what the law provides, and what the proper process requires. That is all that this government, this administration, can say)," Castro said in a Palace briefing on Tuesday, Sept. 15. "Hindi kailangang umabuso, hindi naman kailangang kulang ang pagtrato sa maaaring nasasangkot. So, dapat lang po ay kung ano iyong naaayon sa batas at proseso (There is no need for abuse, nor should there be any improper or inadequate treatment of anyone who may be involved. What is important is that everything is done in accordance with the law and due process)," Castro stressed. The Palace official, however, explained that as long as the court has not yet rendered a final judgment in the Romualdez case, the presumption of innocence remains. "Kahit po nasa kulungan sinuman, in general po, ito ating isasagot: Hangga't wala pa po kasing naibibigay na paghuhusga with finality ang isang korte, ang presumption pa rin po niyan ay inosente sila. Nagkataon lang po na ang mga kasong kinakaharap nila ay no bail, no bail recommended ang ibinibigay at sinasabi at pinag-uutos ng korte (Even if someone is in detention, in general, this is what we can say: As long as a court has not yet rendered a final judgment, the presumption remains that the person is innocent. It just so happens that the cases they are facing are non-bailable, or the court has recommended or ordered that no bail be granted)," Castro said. Asked how the public would perceive Romualdez’s arrest and transfer to jail, Castro said the case should demonstrate that no one is exempt from accountability. "Kung ano po ang sinasapit ngayon ng mga diumanong sangkot, iyan naman po ay walang dapat sinisino – mayaman, mahirap, ordinaryong tao, may kapangyarihan (Whatever the alleged individuals involved are experiencing now, no one should be exempted from accountability—whether rich or poor, an ordinary person or someone in a position of power)," Castro said. "Kung nakagawa man ng mali sa taumbayan, kailangan lang din pong pantay-pantay kung ano po ang naranasan ng mga akusado. So wala pong dapat na special treatment. Hindi po kinakailangang mag-rally kung saan-saan para hindi mapanagot ang sinuman, dapat po pantay-pantay. If someone has done something wrong against the people, they should receive equal treatment and face the same consequences as other accused persons. There should be no special treatment. There is no need to hold rallies here and there to prevent anyone from being held accountable. Everyone should be treated equally)," Castro added. Romualdez was transferred to the Quezon City jail on Monday night from the University of the Philippines-Philippine General Hospital (UP-PGH) in Manila after doctors found him "clinically stable." President Marcos was scheduled to visit the UP-PGH on Monday morning, but it was cancelled. Asked whether Romualdez' stay at the hospital had something to do with the cancelation of the President's engagement, Castro said Marcos' schedule at the hospital did not push through because of the President's schedule from India. Castro said the President had just arrived in early hours of Monday morning and his visit to PGH was also scheduled in the morning. "As you know, the President arrived at almost 5 a.m. We were not informed of the time he was supposed to go to PGH, if he was indeed going there, because he had just returned from India and had only just finished his work. He arrived at almost 5 a.m," Castro said in Filipino. “Aside from that, he also had an event related to his ‘Handog ng Pangulo’ program. So, whatever the reason may have been, nothing was mentioned to us. Most probably, it was because of his schedule," she added. Asked if Malacañang would encourage the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) to release more photos of Romualdez, Castro said it is up to the bureau. "Kung ano po ang nakikita nilang nararapat, as long na ang mga akusado ay nasa kustodiya po nila, nasa kanilang kamay na po ang pagpapasiya niyan (Whatever they deem appropriate, as long as the accused are in their custody, the decision is in their hands)," Castro said.

ph.title: Sri Lanka's javelin champ returns to 'broken' welcome
ph.description:
Colombo: Sri Lanka's Asian Games medal prospect Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage returned home after winning the title at a top international event on Tuesday to find his prized javelins in pieces.

The 23-year-old rising star, who has taken the javelin world by storm this year with a series of impressive victories, was heartbroken to discover that his javelins had snapped.

"This was a rude shock," Pathirage's coach, Tony Prasanna, told AFP. "We checked in five javelins -- all packed extremely carefully and well -- but all of them arrived broken."

Pathirage posted a photograph of his damaged javelins on social media, listing the distance he had thrown them; "85.98, 92.62, 88.50, 89.20, 89.37, 88.20, 89.68, 92.06, 91.06 good bye".

Pathirage was returning from the World Athletics Ultimate Championships in Hungary on Turkish Airlines, and had lodged a complaint.

There was no immediate comment from the airline.

"It is not the cost of a javelin, which is quite high, but the emotional attachment," Prasanna said.

"This is a psychological setback for Rumesh and I will counsel him on it. We were planning to take three of these javelins to the 2028 Olympics and to the Asian Games."

Sri Lanka's Ministry of Sports said it would provide new javelins for Pathirage to compete at the Asian Games in Japan's Nagoya.

"The government will take up this matter with the airline and take appropriate legal action," the ministry said in a statement.

The ministry said that Pathirage -- the first Sri Lankan to become a Diamond League champion -- was the country's gold-medal hopeful at the Asian Games.

Pathirage hurled a world-leading 92.62 metres (303.87 feet) in the Rome Diamond League meet on June 4, and in Zurich last month his 92.07 saw him become only the fourth man in history to exceed 92m twice.

At the Asian Games, he will face Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem, who holds the Asian record of 92.97m.

India's javelin star Neeraj Chopra is injured and unable to defend his Asian Games gold.

ph.title: Back-to-back wins underscore SM Hotels’ commitment to inclusion, engagement, and the growth of its people
ph.description: SM Hotels and Conventions Corporation (SMHCC) has earned consecutive recognition from two distinguished award-giving bodies, affirming the company’s continued dedication in creating a workplace where people are empowered to grow, connect, and go beyond. SMHCC was named Diversity & Inclusion Champion at the 2026 Altaris Business Awards – Human Resources Awards, a global awards program recognizing business innovation and success across industries. The company also emerged as a finalist for Learning & Development Excellence and Talent Acquisition Excellence, making SMHCC the only company to appear three times among the seven organizations named to the finalists and winners list. The recognition highlights SMHCC’s approach to fostering an inclusive workplace where employees across generations, abilities, backgrounds, and identities are given equitable opportunities to contribute and advance. Its entry showcased initiatives developing and celebrating women in traditionally male-dominated roles, LGBTQ+ inclusion, and forging partnerships with organizations that advocate for persons with disabilities and senior citizens, as well as community-based programs, which extend the principles of inclusion beyond the workplace. SMHCC’s Learning & Development Excellence finalist recognition further underscores its structured learning culture, with programs such as We Go Beyond, leadership and capability-building initiatives like R.I.S.E. and L.E.A.D. Beyond, and specialized training that support employees across technical, service, leadership, and personal competencies. Meanwhile, its Talent Acquisition Excellence finalist recognition reflects a talent strategy that goes beyond filling vacancies by building sustainable talent pipelines through strategic sourcing, school and institutional partnerships, internships, inclusive recruitment, and employer branding. Adding to this momentum, SMHCC was also named a winner of the Best Employee Engagement Program at the TalentView People Insights Awards 2026, which recognizes organizations transforming the future of work through meaningful workplace and people initiatives. The award recognizes SMHCC’s deliberate efforts to strengthen employee connection, belonging, and engagement through a culture of listening, meaningful experiences, growth, recognition, and open communication. Programs such as We Go Beyond Pocket Sessions, HR Hour, Wednesday Wisdom, Kapihan, Stay Interviews, HAY Sessions, and the President’s Go Beyond Awards create regular opportunities for employees to engage with leaders, share their voices, learn, receive recognition, and build stronger relationships across the organization. “These recognitions affirm that our people strategies are not simply programs on paper. They are reflected in the experiences of our employees every day,” said Charmagne Adonis, SMHCC Vice President for Human Resources and Organizational Development. “For us, going beyond means creating an environment where every person feels heard, valued, connected, and empowered to contribute. Whether through inclusion, learning, talent development, or engagement, we remain committed to building a culture where our people can grow with the organization and, in turn, help us go beyond what is expected.” The back-to-back recognitions reinforce SMHCC’s belief that organizational excellence begins with investing in people. By bringing together inclusive opportunities, continuous learning, strategic talent development, and meaningful employee engagement, SMHCC continues to strengthen a people culture that supports both individual potential and the organization’s goals in the hospitality and conventions industry. For SMHCC, these awards are more than external validation. They are a reflection of a workplace culture built with its people, sustained by its people, and driven by their collective commitment to go beyond.

ph.title: Rizza Dizon wants Ryzza Mae’s boyfriend to be kind, loving to parents
ph.description: Ryzza Mae Dizon is all grown up. At 21, the popular “Eat Bulaga” host is no longer the little girl viewers first came to know on television. And as she has grown older, many of her fans have also become eager to see her paired with fellow celebrities. Among those linked to Ryzza Mae by fans are fellow “Eat Bulaga” personalities Bimby Aquino and Hyeonyul Kim, who won EB’s “Foreignoy: The AFAM Invasion” segment in 2025. But what does her mother, Rizza Dizon, think about the possibility of Ryzza Mae having a boyfriend? Mommy Rizza sees no problem with it, maintaining she would be supportive if and when her daughter eventually decides to date. “Okay lang po, kung talagang gusto na ni Ryzza, support lang po ako palagi,” Rizza told us following her contract signing as endorser for Luxe Beauty and Wellness Group. But she also has a few thoughts about what would make an ideal boyfriend for Ryzza Mae. “Yung mabait at mapagmahal sa magulang,” she said. Still, the mother made it clear that while she may have her own idea of what makes a good boyfriend, she will not choose one for her daughter. “Kung sino po yung magugustuhan ng anak ko, kung sino yung magmamahal sa kanya at mamahalin din niya, support po ako,” she said. When asked whom she favored between Bimby and Hyeonyul, Rizza shyly replied, “None yet, I don’t know.” She did, however, have kind words for Bimby, whom she said she had met a few times. “Ay, okay naman po. Mabait po,” Rizza said. She also admitted being surprised by how much Bimby had grown since she last saw him in Japan when he was still a child. “Nung nakita ko siya noong birthday ni Ryzza, ayun, nagulat ako kasi sobrang taas na niya,” she said. Rizza further described Bimby as “napakabait” and “magalang.” For now, Ryzza Mae remains focused on her career, while Rizza continues to be a constant presence behind the scenes, and increasingly in front of the camera herself. Rizza is the face of Team Ryzza, which has 3.8 million followers on Facebook. The page features the food she prepares for her family, including the baon she makes for Ryzza Mae. “Gumigising po ako ng maaga para lutuin ang baon ni Ryzza. Tapos hinahatid ko po sa 'Eat Bulaga,'” she said. Team Ryzza also features her other children, Nicole, Nathaniel, and Ken. Rizza said they all work together because they do not have household help and manage things on their own. Despite her growing popularity online, Rizza remains focused on keeping her family grounded. When asked how she handles negative comments about Ryzza Mae, she admitted, “Syempre po bilang nanay, nasasaktan po tayo pag sinasabihan yung anak natin ng ganun, ganito, ganyan...” But she teaches her daughter not to engage with critics. “Hayaan mo lang sila, anak,” Rizza said. “Basta, ang importante, magdasal ka lang palagi sa Panginoon.” Rizza also shared that Ryzza Mae has given her similar advice as she builds her career as an online personality. “Sinasabi niya na lagi magpapasalamat. Tapos, huwag papansinin ang ibang sinasabi ng mga tao,” she said.

ph.title: DOJ summons Robin over Bato's Senate escape
ph.description: The Department of Justice (DOJ) has summoned the Sen. Robin Padilla amid the ongoing investigation into his alleged role in the escape of fellow senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa during the controversial May 14 Senate gunfire incident. In the subpoena, Padilla was asked to appear before the panel of DOJ investigators on Sept. 25 and Oct. 9. The same document mandated the senator to submit his counter-affidavit on the case of Obstruction of Justice referred to by the Philippine National Police. The PNP, through the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) referred the case against Padilla and at least five people, including a former military official who now serves as his deputy chief of staff, for allegedly facilitating the escape of Dela Rosa. The CIDG said Padilla took advantage of the gunfire to lead Dela Rosa out of the Senate where the latter sought refuge when the issuance of an arrest warrant from the International Criminal Court (ICC) was confirmed. Dela Rosa is facing crimes against humanity as a co-perpetrator of drug war during the Duterte administration. Dela Rosa was then at the Senate to participate in the ouster of then Senate president Tito Sotto and election of Sen. Alan Cayetano as his replacement. A gunfire was heard on the night of May 14 and the camp of Cayetano alleged that it was because of the attempt of the National Bureau of Investigation to forcibly get Dela Rosa. The CIDG later said that the Senate gunfire and Dela Rosa’s escape were related, Padilla, on the other hand, confirmed that a subpoena was issued on him through a social media post.

ph.title: PH urges ASEAN to brace for disasters beyond known risks
ph.description: Amid increasingly complex climate threats, the Philippines rallied its Southeast Asian neighbors on Tuesday, Sept. 15, to prepare for disasters that go beyond traditional hazards, warning that emerging risks driven by climate change and rapid development could overwhelm existing systems. During the opening of the ASEAN Ministerial Conference on Disaster Resilience (AMCDR) in Pasay City, hosted by the Office of Civil Defense (OCD), President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. said the region must strengthen its ability to anticipate hazards and prepare for risks that have yet to be fully understood. “We must be prepared for risks we have yet to see. We must make responsible use of emerging technologies to improve how we understand risk, anticipate impacts, and make decisions,” Marcos said in a message delivered by Executive Secretary Ralph Recto. In the Philippines alone, the changing climate has resulted in the country experiencing four to five strong typhoons in a month, which often enhance the southwest monsoon (habagat), causing loss of lives and damage to property, infrastructure, and agriculture. The country also frequently experiences earthquakes and volcanic eruptions as it lies along the Pacific Ring of Fire, a zone around the Pacific Ocean where several tectonic plates meet and is characterized by frequent earthquakes, volcanic activity, and tectonic movement. During the conference, Manila stressed that ASEAN is marking the 20th anniversary of the ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response (AADMER), the region’s legally binding framework for disaster risk reduction and emergency response. Special Envoy of the President on Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Maria Antonia Yulo Loyzaga said the region’s exposure to hazards was being compounded by a rapidly changing climate and the pace of development. The Philippines ranked first in the World Risk Index last year, and Loyzaga said ASEAN’s security and prosperity would increasingly depend on how its members adapt to interconnected risks while maintaining regional and cross-sectoral cooperation. The 2024 ASEAN Report on Strengthening ASEAN Multi-Hazard End-to-End Early Warning System for Natural Disasters also identified gaps among member states in risk knowledge, communication, hazard detection and monitoring capabilities, underscoring the need for stronger regional disaster management. “As you well know, the Asia Pacific is the most disaster-prone region in the world. And the disasters that we face have grown in frequency, intensity and complexity due in large part to a rapidly changing climate and the pace and trajectory of our development as a region,” Loyzaga said. “Against this backdrop, the security and prosperity of our ASEAN region increasingly depends on two factors. First, on how we adapt as individual nations and as a collective whole to complex and cascading risks. And second, on how we uphold our commitment to regional and cross-sectoral cooperation within the rules-based international order,” she added. The two-day AMCDR is being held until Wednesday, Sept. 16, as part of the country’s 2026 ASEAN Chairmanship. The conference brings together disaster management officials, international organizations, development partners, experts, private sector representatives, and civil society groups to discuss risks that can trigger wider disruptions to communities, economies and supply chains. Strengthening disaster management Among the Philippines’ initiatives to strengthen disaster management is the proposed Manila ASEAN Strategic Protocol for Emergency and Comprehensive Transformation, or Manila Aspect Framework, which seeks to improve disaster response and coordination among ASEAN member states. The Philippines has also advanced the Resilient, Innovative, Sustainable, and Empowered (RISE) ASEAN Agenda, which aims to strengthen family resilience, support young people and promote inclusive development for vulnerable communities. At the national level, the government cited the signing into law of the Declaration of State of Imminent Disasters Act, which allows national and local governments to mobilize resources ahead of highly probable and imminent disasters. The country also highlighted its National Adaptation Plan covering 2023 to 2050, which it submitted to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change in May 2024. The Philippines became the third ASEAN member state and the 56th country in the world to submit such a plan. ‘Increasingly systemic disaster risks’ Indonesian National Disaster Management Authority Deputy Minister and ASEAN Ministerial Meeting on Disaster Management Chair Dr. Abdul Muhari warned that disaster risks are becoming increasingly systemic. “The nature of disaster risk is changing, and it's changing faster than many of our systems are designed to cope with. Disasters are increasingly systemic and cascading in nature. A single hazard may no longer produce a single consequence,” Muhari said in his speech. He cited climate change, rapid urbanization, environmental degradation, demographic pressures, economic interdependence and growing reliance on critical infrastructure as factors creating new layers of vulnerability. “Flooding can interrupt electricity, and the loss of electricity can disrupt telecommunications, water supply, hospitals, transportation, and in particular, government services,” he noted. Muhari said preparedness could no longer focus solely on protecting individual facilities and equipment. “Our responsibility is to protect the functioning of the system as a whole, because the real test of resilience is not simply whether the infrastructure, in example, survives a disaster. It is whether society can continue to function under extreme stresses,” he added. Muhari called for a shift toward systemic resilience by understanding interdependencies, identifying possible points of failure, strengthening interoperability, establishing alternative service pathways and ensuring continuity of operations across governments, communities, businesses and regional mechanisms. He said the ASEAN Sustainable Resilience Framework provides an opportunity to move from managing individual disasters to addressing interconnected risks. This, he added, should remain coherent with the ASEAN Community Vision 2045 and the ASEAN Socio-Cultural Community Strategy Plan. “In other words, we must prepare not only for disasters that we expect, but also for disasters that exceed our expectations and capacities,” he said. For his part, ASEAN Deputy Secretary-General for the ASEAN Socio-Cultural Community San Lwin said climate-induced disasters were becoming more frequent and serious, while rapid urbanization, environmental degradation, technological disruptions and other emerging risks were increasing existing vulnerabilities. “These challenges remind us that disaster resilience cannot be addressed by any country or sector alone. Stronger partnerships, innovation, knowledge sharing, and collective actions are essential to safeguarding our people's economies and development gains,” San Lwin said in his remarks. He said resilience must involve anticipating risks, reducing vulnerabilities, protecting development gains and ensuring communities can withstand and recover from future shocks. “For ASEAN, resilience is not simply about responding effectively when disasters occur. It is also about anticipating risks, reducing vulnerabilities, protecting development gains, and ensuring that our communities are better prepared to face future challenges,” he said.

Colombo: Sri Lanka's Asian Games medal prospect Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage returned home after winning the title at a top international event on Tuesday to find his prized javelins in pieces.

The 23-year-old rising star, who has taken the javelin world by storm this year with a series of impressive victories, was heartbroken to discover that his javelins had snapped.

"This was a rude shock," Pathirage's coach, Tony Prasanna, told AFP. "We checked in five javelins -- all packed extremely carefully and well -- but all of them arrived broken."

Pathirage posted a photograph of his damaged javelins on social media, listing the distance he had thrown them; "85.98, 92.62, 88.50, 89.20, 89.37, 88.20, 89.68, 92.06, 91.06 good bye".

Pathirage was returning from the World Athletics Ultimate Championships in Hungary on Turkish Airlines, and had lodged a complaint.

There was no immediate comment from the airline.

"It is not the cost of a javelin, which is quite high, but the emotional attachment," Prasanna said.

"This is a psychological setback for Rumesh and I will counsel him on it. We were planning to take three of these javelins to the 2028 Olympics and to the Asian Games."

Sri Lanka's Ministry of Sports said it would provide new javelins for Pathirage to compete at the Asian Games in Japan's Nagoya.

"The government will take up this matter with the airline and take appropriate legal action," the ministry said in a statement.

The ministry said that Pathirage -- the first Sri Lankan to become a Diamond League champion -- was the country's gold-medal hopeful at the Asian Games.

Pathirage hurled a world-leading 92.62 metres (303.87 feet) in the Rome Diamond League meet on June 4, and in Zurich last month his 92.07 saw him become only the fourth man in history to exceed 92m twice.

At the Asian Games, he will face Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem, who holds the Asian record of 92.97m.

India's javelin star Neeraj Chopra is injured and unable to defend his Asian Games gold.

bd.title: Confitex Technology wins INDEX Award and Hygienix Innovation Award for world-first washable nonwoven absorbent hygiene products
bd.description: Reusable absorbent hygiene manufacturer Confitex Technology has won the hygiene industry's two top innovation awards, validating washable alternatives to single-use period and incontinence pads and liners – and signaling a more sustainable future for personal hygiene. AUCKLAND, New Zealand , Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Confitex Technology has become the first company to win both of the global nonwovens industry's top awards – the INDEX Award , presented at the INDEX26 expo in Geneva in May 2026, and the Hygienix Innovation Award , presented in the US in November 2025. Its breakthrough washable nonwoven absorbent hygiene products prove that the nonwoven materials used in single-use pads, liners, incontinence guards and bed pads can be stabilised to survive machine washing and tumble drying, and excellent absorbency can be achieved without petroleum-based superabsorbent polymers (SAPs). A single-use sanitary pad (left) compared with a Confitex Technology washable nonwoven reusable pad (right), which looks, feels and performs like a single-use pad but can be machine washed and tumble dried more than 30 times. Confitex Technology Founder and CEO Frantisek Riha-Scott says the implications are huge. "What Confitex Technology has done is unlock an entirely new product category – washable, reusable absorbent hygiene products that perform as well as, or better than, disposables, at a price point that works for mainstream consumers and mass-market retailers. It's the beginning of a consumer category shift comparable to the move from single-use plastic bags to reusables." The global absorbent hygiene products (AHP) market is valued at about USD 123.5 billion, with reusable products making up less than 15 percent but growing at a CAGR of 6.89%. EU regulatory pressure supports a move away from single-use plastic products, and the French government recently announced menstrual equity subsidies for reusable period underwear at population scale. The INDEX Award jury – a panel of global industry experts convened by Brussels-based AHP industry body EDANA – highlighted the market opportunity: "By making absorbent nonwovens fully laundry-compatible, the technology enables nonwoven suppliers to enter the rapidly growing reusable market, historically dominated by textile products. At the same time, the product delivers improved absorbency, leak protection and ease of care for users, while supporting sustainability goals through reusability and the use of predominantly natural-based fibres." Confitex Technology's award-winning nonwoven reusable pads are up to 90 percent bio-based, contain no SAPS, and have been independently lab-tested by Intertek to match or exceed the absorbency of single-use equivalents. All incoming bulk raw materials are tested for PFAS 'forever chemicals' and all Confitex Technology products meet OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certification. Confitex Technology Executive Director Lisa Voyle says the company is partnering with global retailers and leading FMCG players to build the washable nonwoven category for mainstream adoption across European and North American markets. About the awards The INDEX Awards are presented triennially by Brussels-based nonwovens association EDANA and considered the industry's highest accolade. The Hygienix Innovation Award is presented annually by US-based industry body INDA to honour breakthrough technologies advancing the AHP industry. About Confitex Technology Confitex Technology is the tech leader in reusable absorbent hygiene – designing and manufacturing washable absorbent hygiene products (including reusable period pads and liners, period underwear, incontinence underwear, incontinence products, maternity products, pet products, baby products and bed pads) on behalf of private-label retailers, brands and distributors worldwide from its own automated facilities in Asia and Europe. Confitex Technology's innovations are protected by over 60 granted patents and its operations hold ISO 13485, EU Medical Device CE Mark, MDSAP, OEKO-TEX STeP, Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Business Social Compliance Initiative (BSCI), Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), Recycled Claim Standard (RCS) and FSC Chain of Custody (FSC CoC) certifications. bd.title: SUS ENVIRONMENT Signs MOU with Standard Chartered and Asakabank to Deepen Green Cooperation in Central Asia
bd.description: HONG KONG , Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SUS ENVIRONMENT has signed a Memoranda of Understanding (MOU) with Standard Chartered and Uzbekistan's state-owned Asakabank, marking a new step in strengthening business connections between Hong Kong SAR and Central Asia and advancing sustainable development in the region. The cooperation brings together SUS ENVIRONMENT's expertise in environmental infrastructure with the financial capabilities and regional market strengths of the two banks. It is expected to open new opportunities across trade, treasury management, financing and liquidity, supporting the development of green projects and deeper cross-border collaboration. Central Asia has become an increasingly important part of SUS ENVIRONMENT's global business. In Uzbekistan, the company is investing in and developing waste-to-energy projects in Samarkand and Kashkadarya, each with a designed waste treatment capacity of 1,500 tonnes per day. By turning municipal solid waste into clean energy, the projects are expected to improve local waste management while contributing to greener and more sustainable urban development. The latest cooperation also builds on SUS ENVIRONMENT's established relationship with Standard Chartered. In 2025, SUS ENVIRONMENT completed the initial US$175 million fundraising for China's first sustainability-linked syndicated loan in the waste-to-energy sector, with Standard Chartered serving as sole mandated lead arranger and bookrunner. For SUS ENVIRONMENT, these partnerships go beyond finance. By combining international financial expertise, local market insight and environmental solutions, the company aims to help sustainable ideas move from plans to real projects. Looking ahead, SUS ENVIRONMENT will continue working with global and local partners to explore new cooperation opportunities, deepen the Hong Kong SAR –Central Asia business corridor, and contribute to the global green transition and sustainable development. About SUS ENVIRONMENT SUS ENVIRONMENT is the world's largest provider of waste incineration equipment and technology, as well as one of the top three investors and operators of waste-to-energy plants (low-carbon Eco-industrial parks) globally. As of December 2025, SUS ENVIRONMENT has established 11 management centers worldwide, providing environmental and energy services to over 100 million people. It has invested in and constructed over 90 waste-to-energy plants (low-carbon Eco-industrial parks), with a daily processing capacity nearly 120,000 tonnes of municipal solid waste. The annual green power generation is approximately 20,000 GWh, sufficient to meet the annual electricity needs of nearly 8 million households. Its equipment and technology are applied in over 300 waste-to-energy plants across the world, with a daily capacity over 300,000 tonnes of municipal solid waste.

أمطار غزيرة على جازان

ونبَّه المركز الوطني للأرصاد اليوم الثلاثاء، من هطول أمطار متوسطة إلى غزيرة على منطقة جازان، يصاحبها رياح شديدة السرعة، وشبه انعدام في مدى الرؤية الأفقية، وتساقط البرد، وجريان السيول، وصواعق رعدية، على مدينة جازان ومحافظات الحرث، والدائر (بني مالك)، والريث، والعارضة، والعيدابي، وفيفا، وهروب، والطوال، وصامطة، وأحد المسارحة، وأبو عريش، وضمد، وصبيا، والدرب، وبيش، ومركز الفطيحة، وجزيرة فرسان.
وبيّن المركز أن الحالة تستمر -بمشيئة الله تعالى- حتى الساعة الثامنة مساءً.

sa.title: المملكة تُشارك العالم العربي الاحتفاء باليوم العربي للأرصاد الجوية
sa.description:
احتفى المركز الوطني للأرصاد اليوم، بـ"اليوم العربي للأرصاد الجوية"، الذي يوافق الخامس عشر من سبتمبر من كل عام، تحت شعار «استثمارنا في الأرصاد الجوية.. استثمار في مستقبل آمن»، تأكيدًا لأهمية الاستثمار في القدرات الأرصادية والتقنيات الحديثة والكفاءات البشرية، ودورها في حماية الأرواح والممتلكات، وتعزيز الجاهزية للظواهر الجوية، ودعم التنمية المستدامة.

وأوضح الرئيس التنفيذي للمركز الوطني للأرصاد الدكتور أيمن بن سالم غلام، أن شعار هذا العام يجسد أهمية الاستثمار في الأرصاد الجوية بوصفه استثمارًا في سلامة المجتمع ومستقبله، مبينًا أن تطوير منظومات الرصد والتنبؤ والإنذار المبكر يسهم في توفير معلومات موثوقة تدعم اتخاذ القرار.

تطوير البنية التحتية


وأشار إلى أن الاستثمار في العمل الأرصادي يشمل تطوير البنية التحتية والتقنيات، وتأهيل الكفاءات الوطنية، ودعم البحث العلمي، وتعزيز القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتوظيفها في تقديم خدمات تلبي احتياجات المستفيدين، مؤكدًا أن تكامل هذه العناصر يمثل أساسًا للارتقاء بجودة الخدمات الأرصادية وتعظيم أثرها في مختلف القطاعات.

وبيّن الدكتور غلام أن المعلومات الأرصادية والمناخية تؤدي دورًا أساسيًا في دعم قطاعات المياه والزراعة والطاقة والنقل والبيئة، من خلال مساندة التخطيط والتشغيل وإدارة الموارد، وتعزيز القدرة على التكيف مع التغيرات المناخية، بما يسهم في استمرارية الأعمال ورفع كفاءة الاستعداد للمخاطر.

تعزيز التعاون العربي


ولفت إلى أهمية تعزيز التعاون العربي في تبادل البيانات والخبرات وتطوير القدرات، ودور المراكز الإقليمية التي تستضيفها المملكة والمعتمدة من المنظمة العالمية للأرصاد الجوية في دعم العمل المشترك لمواجهة تحديات الطقس والمناخ، مشيرًا إلى أن هذه المناسبة تمثل فرصة لتعزيز الوعي بقيمة الاستثمار في الأرصاد، وترسيخ الشراكة بين الجهات المعنية والمجتمع لبناء مستقبل أكثر أمانًا واستدامة.

يُذكر أن المملكة صاحبة مبادرة «اليوم العربي للأرصاد الجوية»، إذ قدّمت مقترحها إلى اللجنة العربية الدائمة للأرصاد الجوية عام 2019م، واختير الخامس عشر من سبتمبر موعدًا سنويًا للاحتفاء بهذه المناسبة، إحياءً لذكرى إنشاء اللجنة العربية الدائمة للأرصاد الجوية في 15 سبتمبر 1970م، بموجب قرار مجلس جامعة الدول العربية على المستوى الوزاري، بهدف تنسيق الجهود وتوحيد الأهداف العربية في مجال الأرصاد الجوية.

iq.title: مع الحيطة والحذر.. بدء زيادة الإطلاقات المائية باتجاه بحيرة الحبانية
iq.description: شفق نيوز- الأنبار أعلن محافظ الأنبار عمر مشعان دبوس، يوم الثلاثاء، البدء بزيادة الإيرادات المائية باتجاه بحيرة الحبانية وفق الخطة التشغيلية، بما يعزز خزينها الاستراتيجي بنحو مليار و500 مليون متر مكعب. وقال دبوس في بيان ورد لوكالة شفق نيوز، إن ذلك جاء عقب اتصال هاتفي مع وزير الموارد المائية، مؤكداً أن تعزيز الخزين المائي للبحيرة يمثل خطوة مهمة لدعم الأمن المائي وتنمية قطاعي الزراعة والسياحة في المحافظة. وأشار محافظة الأنبار، إلى استمرار التنسيق مع وزارة الموارد المائية ومتابعة تنفيذ الخطة التشغيلية والمناسيب بما يحقق الاستفادة المثلى من المياه ويحافظ على الخزين. وفي هذا السياق، وجّه محافظ الأنبار الجهات المعنية باتخاذ تدابير الحيطة والحذر في المناطق المحيطة بالبحيرة، ولاسيما قناة الورار وسداد الحماية والمناطق القريبة من حوض الحبانية باتجاه مدينة الرمادي، ومراقبة حركة المواطنين والآليات ومنع التجاوز أو العبث بالسداد، داعياً المواطنين إلى الالتزام بإرشادات السلامة بالتزامن مع زيادة الإيرادات المائية. وفي وقت سابق، أفاد مدير مدينة الحبانية السياحية مؤيد المشوح، لوكالة شفق نيوز، بارتفاع منسوب مياه بحيرة الحبانية بشكل نسبي، ما أسهم في زيادة أعداد السياح والعوائل القادمة إلى المدينة السياحية من مختلف المحافظات العراقية. وكانت وزارة الموارد المائية قد أعلنت منتصف آب/أغسطس الماضي زيادة الإطلاقات المائية الموجهة إلى بحيرة الحبانية بمعدل 40 متراً مكعباً في الثانية، بهدف زيادة الخزين المائي للبحيرة وتعويض النقص الحاصل في مياهها، فضلاً عن تحسين الواقع البيئي والمائي ودعم التجمعات السكانية المحيطة بها. وتحتاج المدينة بحسب مسؤولين، إلى إطلاقات مائية مستمرة تبلغ مليار متر مكعب لاستعادة نشاطها بصورة طبيعية، فيما تحتاج البحيرة إلى نحو 3.5 مليارات متر مكعب لتعود إلى وضعها السابق. وتقع بحيرة الحبانية بين مدينتي الرمادي والفلوجة في محافظة الأنبار، وتُعد من أبرز وجهات السياحة الداخلية في العراق، إلا أن تراجع مناسيب المياه وتدهور البنية التحتية للمدينة السياحية خلال السنوات الماضية أثرا في نشاطها السياحي.

tr.title: Bursaspor'un gol makinesi! 'Alem buysa kral Iheanacho'
tr.description: Bursaspor’un çilek transferi Kelechi Iheanacho her hafta farkını ortaya koymaya devam ediyor. Türk futbolseverlerin bir numaralı ilgi odağı olan Nijeryalı futbolcu, çıktığı 7 maçta 11 gole doğrudan etki etti. Gol krallığında zirvede olan 29 yaşında forvet, 9 kez rakip fileleri sarstı. Trendyol 1. Lig’de Süper Lig hedefiyle yoluna emin adımlarla devam eden Bursaspor, 7. hafta sonunda topladığı 16 puanla zirve yarışındaki iddiasını sürdürürken, Nijeryalı golcüsü Kelechi Iheanacho da performansıyla lige damga vurdu. Yeşil-beyazlı ekibin sezon başında kadrosuna kattığı 29 yaşındaki yıldız futbolcu, geride kalan 7 haftanın tamamında rakip fileleri havalandırmayı başardı. 7 maçta 9 gole ulaşan Iheanacho, gol krallığı yarışında zirvede yer alarak Bursaspor'un en önemli hücum silahı olduğunu bir kez daha gösterdi. HER MAÇTA GOL ATTI Bursaspor taraftarlarının kısa sürede sevgilisi haline gelen Nijeryalı santrfor, oynadığı her karşılaşmada gol atarak dikkat çekici bir istikrar yakaladı. Iheanacho, sezonun ilk haftasında Bodrum FK, ardından Iğdır FK, Fatih Karagümrük ve Kayserispor karşılaşmalarında birer kez fileleri havalandırdı. İstanbulspor ve Manisa FK maçlarında ise ikişer gol atan yıldız futbolcu, son olarak Esenler Erokspor karşısında da takımının golünü kaydetti. Böylece 7 maçta 9 gole ulaşan Iheanacho, gol krallığı yarışında zirveye yerleşti. EROKSPOR MAÇINDA 3 GOLÜ OFSAYTA TAKILDI Iheanacho'nun Esenler Erokspor karşısındaki performansı ise skor tabelasına yansıyanın çok daha ötesindeydi. Nijeryalı golcünün rakip filelerle buluşturduğu 3 gol, ofsayt gerekçesiyle geçerli sayılmadı. Buna rağmen bir gol kaydetmeyi başaran Iheanacho, 7. hafta sonunda gol sayısını 9'a yükseltti. Bu sürede 2 de asist yapan Nijeryalı krampon, 11 gole doğrudan etki etti. Her hafta rakip savunmalar için daha büyük bir tehdit haline gelen Iheanacho, Bursaspor'un Süper Lig yürüyüşünde en önemli kozlarından biri olmayı sürdürüyor.

tn.title: خلال الأشهر الـ7 الأولى من 2026 .. ارتفاع إنتاج الكهرباء في تونس بـ6%
tn.description: ارتفع إنتاج الكهرباء في تونس بنسبة 6 بالمائة خلال الأشهر السبعة الأولى من سنة 2026، ليبلغ 12333 جيغاوات ساعة، مقابل 11632 جيغاوات ساعة خلال الفترة ذاتها من سنة 2025، وفق معطيات التقرير الدوري حول الظرف الطاقي الصادر عن المرصد الوطني للطاقة والمناجم. وسجل إنتاج الكهرباء من الطاقات المتجددة، التي تشمل الطاقة الشمسية وطاقة الرياح..، ارتفاعا بنسبة 61 بالمائة خلال الفترة نفسها، لترتفع مساهمتها في مزيج إنتاج الكهرباء الوطني إلى 9 بالمائة موفى جويلية 2026. ويعزى هذا التطور، وفق المعطيات ذاتها، إلى النمو المسجل في مشاريع الإنتاج المستقل للطاقة، ولا سيما مشاريع الطاقة الشمسية الموجهة للاستهلاك الذاتي والإنتاج الخاص. وفي هذا الإطار، بلغ إجمالي تركيبات الطاقة الشمسية الكهروضوئية حوالي 515 ميغاوات في القطاع السكني المرتبط بشبكة الضغط المنخفض، إلى جانب 130 ميغاوات في القطاعات الصناعية والخدمية والفلاحية المرتبطة بشبكتي الضغط المتوسط والعالي. كما ارتفع إنتاج مشاريع الطاقة الشمسية المستقلة إلى 359 جيغاوات ساعة خلال الأشهر السبعة الأولى من 2026، مقابل 39 جيغاوات ساعة خلال الفترة ذاتها من 2025. ويعود هذا الارتفاع، بالخصوص، إلى دخول عدد من المحطات الشمسية الكبرى حيز الاستغلال، على غرار محطة القيروان بقدرة 100 ميغاوات في ديسمبر 2025 ومحطتي سيدي بوزيد وتوزر بقدرة 50 ميغاوات لكل منهما في أفريل 2026. ورغم تنامي مساهمة الطاقات المتجددة، ظل الغاز الطبيعي المصدر الرئيسي لإنتاج الكهرباء، بحصة بلغت 90.8 بالمائة من إجمالي الإنتاج الوطني إلى موفى جويلية 2026. وفي المقابل، تحسنت النجاعة الطاقية لمحطات توليد الكهرباء، إذ تراجع الاستهلاك النوعي الإجمالي بنسبة 3 بالمائة ليبلغ 206 طن مكافئ نفط لكل جيغاوات ساعة. وبلغت ذروة الطلب على الكهرباء خلال شهر جويلية 4924 ميغاوات، مسجلة ارتفاعا بنسبة 2 بالمائة مقارنة بـ4837 ميغاوات خلال جويلية 2025. وغطت الشركة التونسية للكهرباء والغاز 91 بالمائة من الإنتاج الوطني للكهرباء، في حين تراجعت واردات الكهرباء بنسبة 2 بالمائة، لتوفر حوالي 10 بالمائة من حاجيات السوق المحلية. كما ارتفع إجمالي مبيعات الكهرباء بنسبة 1 بالمائة، ليبلغ 9455 جيغاوات ساعة، واستحوذ القطاع الصناعي على الحصة الأكبر من مبيعات الكهرباء ذات الضغط العالي والمتوسط بنسبة 58 بالمائة. . وفي المقابل، سجلت الموارد الوطنية من المحروقات تراجعا خلال الأشهر السبعة الأولى من سنة 2026، إذ انخفض إنتاج النفط الخام بنسبة 11 بالمائة مقارنة بالفترة ذاتها من سنة 2025، ليبلغ نحو 0.78 مليون طن مكافئ نفط، في حين تراجع إنتاج الغاز الطبيعي، بما في ذلك الإنتاج المحلي والإتاوة، بنسبة 14 بالمائة إلى حوالي 0.84 مليون طن مكافئ نفط. وأدى تراجع الإنتاج الوطني من المحروقات، بالتوازي مع استمرار الطلب على الطاقة، إلى ارتفاع العجز التجاري الطاقي بنسبة 8 بالمائة، في وقت انخفضت فيه نسبة الاستقلالية الطاقية من 46 بالمائة خلال الفترة نفسها من سنة 2025 إلى 42 بالمائة موفى جويلية 2026.
